svg.aria-label: Revoker — the agent that lands the revoke before the drainer moves. A wallet grants an unlimited approval, two threat rules fire, the agent zeroes the allowance through KeeperHub, and the drainer fires anyway and takes nothing.

g.text: The agent that lands the revoke
3 threat rules · 86 tests · 46,482 gas per revoke
2 threat rules fired — no human in the loop
drain fired anyway — took 0 · funds untouched
